title: Projection and shift formulas for the canonical closed alpha map
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a closed immersion i:Z -> X and an ordinary integral comparison C [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-recollement-realization]. Suppose closedReduction l E i C is invertible. Use closedLimit and closedAlpha from [def-sf-integral-support-normalization-data]. The canonical closedAlpha respects the specified shifts, and for every integral constructible K and every n its composite with the n-th strict-system limit projection is ordinary direct image of the reconstruction unit followed by the n-th source projection, then sfDerivedRestrictionComparison and the restriction of directEvaluationIso.inv, exactly as in its Lean signature. This asserts only the two normalization identities for this map; it constructs no restricted functor or support package.

proof.text: Scalar restriction and closed direct image evaluate on the same fiber product. Their coefficient actions agree after every finite projection. They therefore define a comparison of the entire quotient diagrams, commuting with transitions. The pull_model and diagrams_unit normalizations of C identify the transpose with closedReduction on good representatives.

Conjugate that square through the specified ordinary and system adjunctions. The resulting right-adjoint comparison is closedLimit. Its nth projection is sfDerivedRestrictionComparison followed by restricted inverse system-direct-image evaluation. Compose with ordinary image of the actual reconstruction unit. Naturality gives precisely the displayed closedAlpha projection formula, before any separate evaluation of derived morphisms.

All degreewise scalar and direct-image maps commute with shifted differentials. The normalized Roos shift multiplies the homotopy coordinate by (-1)^r and retains the projection coordinate. Its actual quotient augmentation has zero homotopy coordinate. Thus the strict comparison, reconstruction unit and their composite respect the prescribed shifts. Localization and constructible restriction preserve this equation, also for zero objects and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem closedAlpha_normalization {Z X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (C : SfOrdinaryIntegralComparison l E i)
    [IsIso (closedReduction l E i C)] :
    NatTrans.CommShift (closedAlpha l E i C) ℤ ∧
    ∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Z) (n : ℕ),
      (closedAlpha l E i C).app K ≫
        (coefficientSequenceProjection l E X n).app
          ((FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l E i).obj
            ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E Z).obj K.obj)) =
      (sfCompletedDerivedDirectImage l E i).map
        (((FrobeniusExchange.models l E).system Z).adjunction.unit.app K.obj ≫
          (coefficientSequenceProjection l E Z n).app
            ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E Z).obj K.obj)) ≫
        (sfDerivedRestrictionComparison l E i n).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Z n).obj
            ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E Z).obj K.obj)) ≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n).map
          ((directEvaluationIso l E i n).inv.app
            ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E Z).obj K.obj))
